productPageReviews.reviewTitle: great casual dress -- comfortable and easy care
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I ordered this dress in Wine Red, size Medium. I usually wear a Medium (size 8/10) and this dress fits me perfectly -- not too loose, nor too snug; the length is about 3" above my ankle which I really like (I'm 5'7").  The neckline is great, a small narrow trim, which I think is prettier, instead of a tee-shirt crew neck.  The neckline is high but not uncomfortably so; it falls about 1.5" below my collar bone, which I really like.  The material is thin but seems durable, especially since it is 60% polyester.  The elastic on the sleeve cuffs is comfortable, not too tight; It gives a nice gather so the sleeves have a little fullness.  I have a dress identical (style and material) to this one except in green and from another brand (Anrabess).  That dress I got last fall and enjoyed wearing it through the fall and winter.  Goes well with a jean jacket.  I did add a tank top underneath in the winter but I live in the South and we don't get very cold weather very often.  Not too many days to wear this up North in the winter.  This dress is about half the cost of the green one but the style and quality are the same -- great find!

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: This dress will make your summer!!!This dress will make your summer!!!
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I absolutely adore these sundresses, and have purchased them in multiple color/patterns. This is a summer must-have!FABRIC/QUALITY: The dress is well made. The fabric is opaque, of excellent quality, and doesn’t wrinkle. I’ve traveled with these and they came out of the suitcase wrinkle-free. They’re a soft, elevated t-shirt material (but also with some stretch). I wash on delicate and hang to dry, dries overnight, comes out looking perfect. Even after multiple washings they continue to look good as new—no shrinkage or fading.FIT/STYLE: Feminine, comfortable, effortless, and flowy. It defines the bust, cinches the waist, and flows into a universally flattering, a-line shape. I wear a half-tee under mine because I’m 63 and a modest dresser, but that’s just me. Dress them up or down as you wish. I’m 5’5”, 115-117 pounds, 34B, 34-27-37 (pear shape body type) and wearing a size medium. I could’ve definitely gone with the small for a closer fit in the body, but it was too short for comfort on me. If you’re like me and love boho/cottage core styles, or want the simplicity of putting on a dress as a one-and-done, ready for the day— then you’ll want to add this one to your collection.These dresses are incredibly soft, comfortable, and ideal for our coastal, subtropical southern summers. I wear mine to lunches and daytime outings with friends, errands, appointments, and casual dinners out with my husband. A wonderful elevated alternative to shorts. I just add simple stud earrings, possibly a delicate necklace, my trainers, and whatever handbag fits my activities for the day.I’m not compensated in any way for my reviews. I  write them because I rely on them myself when shopping online. I hope this review is helpful. Have a wonderful day!

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: Cute! Read size info before ordering though
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: Like many others here, I ordered this because I cannot be convinced to spend 3x as much on the FreePeople Hotshot dress. This little number does not disappoint! It’s cute, the quality is nice and the fabric feels sturdy and not see through. However, do review the sizing info before ordering as it’s a little different than standard sizing. I’m usually a L but I see now after receiving that I could have ordered an M instead. That being said, the L is just fine and I like the length of it so I wonder if M would have been too short. I like the adjustable straps. I don’t think the built in bra would hold my boobs in anyway even if I did size down, but if you are more modestly-chested you could probably skip a bra entirely if you’re wearing this.  Another thing to note, the bottoms are not attached to the dress as advertised! They are separate shorts but still do the trick and are soft and comfortable too.
Seems ok but shorts are not attached. Size down as they are big. Does not look like picture are all. I would wear around house or beach on boat but not out at all.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Cute dress, didn't like the pocketsCute dress, didn't like the pockets
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: This is a review for the casual maxi dress in dark green.I really like the color of the dress. The green is bright enough to be summery, but not so bright that I look like a leprechaun.The dress is well cut and sewn. The seams are solid and the neck is even and has good coverage. It showed a little skin, but wasn't low enough to show cleavage or feel inappropriate. I generally wear a tank top under everything and it did not show at all.I ordered true to my normal size, a 2XL and the dress fit with no problem. I personally would not size down as I wouldn't want the dress any smaller through the stomach.The fabric flows well and moves with you and the material is soft and has room to be stretched it needed.What I really didn't like is the pockets, and that surprised me. I love a dress with pockets, almost always. But, in this dress the pockets kept the dress from lying flat. And I don't carry my weight in my hips. If you're someone who does carry your weight in your hips you may want to size up.I tried the dress with a sash as a belt, but it was not a good look for me. If you're more hourglass shaped, a belt might be brilliant on you.The dress is easy to wash. I will wash it on delicate, just to keep the color vibrant as long as possible, and the dry on air dry.Overall this is a well made, cute maxi dress for summer. I just wish the pockets were less obvious.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Dress is surprisingly nice for the price.
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: The label says 100% cotton, and it genuinely feels like real cotton. The fabric is comfortable, feels well made, and is nice to wear overall. The fit wasn’t quite as flattering as I’d hoped — darts at the chest would have improved it significantly — but I’m still very pleased with the purchase and would consider buying another color at this price point. I did order an XL (from reviews and seeing that it's coming directly from China I usually size up) and I chose well. I think any smaller and it would have been too tight in the chest and the buttons would pucker. For reference I'm 5'5 and about 170lb, 38C/D.My only real issue was with the shipping estimate. I understand sellers can’t fully control shipping carriers, but the delivery date listed was very inaccurate. I ordered this as a gift more than a month in advance, and it still arrived weeks late. When I contacted the seller after about five weeks, they were responsive and helpful, which I appreciated, but they also seemed aware that shipping would take much longer than originally stated. I’d just encourage more honesty and transparency about delivery times.**Update: I've washed and worn it a few times and I'm really liking it. I'm figuring out which color to buy to have another one. The slits on the sides and fit (even though not perfect) are really comfortable and feel nice moving around. I did forget to pull the dress out of the dryer straight away and it was a bit wrinkly, but all I needed to do was mist it down and shake it out a few times and it looked great. The bottom hem could use a little ironing, but for what I was wearing it for I didn't care.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Nice dress, but not for short gals.
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I am 5' tall, 160 lbs, apple shape.  I wanted this dress to work so badly that I even ordered it twice.  First, a size L (I usually wear 14P).  Tight across the chest and waist.  It appears to be cotton, made, fairly well, and decent fabric. So, I re-ordered an XL. productPageReviews.reviewTitle: So far, love it, hope it holds up well in the wash
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: 7.28.26. Edited to add that it machine washes well and can use an ironing but not required. I hang to dry. Hasn’t faded after several wears and three washings.  The yellow and green were only slightly sheer at the white stripe but I did return them.I love this straight out of the package. Hopefully it does not fade in the wash, the colors are woven in, not printed so that will help.  Thin cotton, definitely needs ironing, but will be cool to wear. The waist gathering is hi-lo and very flattering on a busty figure. Pockets are roomy and there seems to be extra care taken with the pocket seams so they lay flat, although they are not tacked to the inside of the dress. The sleeves are one of my favorite features, they come to an inch or so above my elbows, almost batwing style, and there are no extra folds or cuffs, just a nice wide French seam. The overall length is about 6” above my ankles and the buttons extend modestly to mid shin.Will be ordering more colors

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: For just north of $20, this was a great find! I am 5'5.5" tall, about 132 pounds, 32DD - lean, athletic build. I purchased this in both the size small and size medium, but kept the small. The medium ended up being a bit too loose in the chest and had some extra material on one side of the hips (maybe a manufacturing flaw here). The small fit a bit more snuggly around the narrowest part of my waistline, completely covered the girls with no extra material and did not have any odd material fold on the hip area.I am quite long in the torso and the narrowest part of my waist lives right under my bust, so the waistline of this dress rides a bit higher on me than on the model, but I like it.  And again, even though I am a 32DD, I have no cleavage exposure and the v-neck stays closed without the modesty clips (although they are super cute). I like the sleeves on this dress. They are longer than cap sleeves (thank goodness), but not so long that they look frumpy. They hit at a perfect spot on the upper arm.The material is light enough for summer in the south and reminds me of a combo of jersey tee and slinky. It's not the best quality, but the dress is also $20ish.Wrap dresses (including mock ones like this) are incredibly flattering on just about all body types and this one is no exception.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Update to my review below. I ordered the black and the lighter blue dress in a size XL and they fit nice, the stitching was the same color as the fabric and the fabric was the same color inside and out.  I also expanded the picture for the floral green dress and it appears to have green stitching. However, the constant inconsistencies I've  inexperienced here prevents from getting the green floral dress as it may arrive with the white stitching. Since I'm happy with the other dresses, I'm upgrading my review to 4 stars.I ordered two of these dresses. One green in size L and one red in the size XL.  For reference, I am 40D, 5'6 and 169lbs.  The dresses are a tad above my knee cap so perfect for me.The reason for the different sizes ordered is because I ordered the red one with flowers first in the size L about a year or so ago from a different company through Amazon called Fensace.  The fit was snug around the bust area and I had to wear a safety pin so that it would not look too sexy for work.  However I loved the dress. I thought this was the same company when I made the recent order.So with this company, Rumia, I ordered the red in XL. Same exact dress, but when I tried it on the dress was loose. I decided to keep it for work and use the other one for going out and about.  So I give the red dress 5 stars. It also came with a little flower clip so that you can pin it close around the bust line.I then decided to order the green dress in a size L because I loved the green print with the large white flowers. The pattern was very pretty and the fit was really nice, but I could not get past how cheap it looked, especially with white stitching compared to the red dress.  I believe it's because the red dress is full of little white flowers so it hides the stitching and the green dress has more green material because the flowers are big and strategically placed. So one could see the white stitching against the green material. Also, since the material is white inside, it kind of showed through if stretched, as in the bust line. So if you have a snug fit anywhere, the white will show. There was also thread hanging from it. I would not even use it for running errands or for being out and about. So I returned it.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: ​I am overall very pleased with this dress. The material feels high quality, and the fit is really lovely and flattering.​The only reason I am deducting one star is due to the color accuracy. I ordered the "Plain Purple" option, but in person, the shade is actually a light pastel pink—just a shade darker than baby pink. If you don't mind receiving a light pink dress instead of purple, I highly recommend it for its quality and fit!

The v neck elongates the neck without showing cleavage, which is perfect for the workplace.There is nothing I don't like about this dress. I bought the shorter version and another maxi with no sleeves, all in different colors. The fabric is good quality and 100% cotton. The lining is not cotton, but that helps the top skirt flow freely around your legs. The dress is not see though at all.It is very hot here in California and the dress was quite cool to wear to work. productPageReviews.reviewTitle: What were they thinking with the POLYESTER lining??What were they thinking with the POLYESTER lining??
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: This is a beautiful cotton dress....that is until you put it on and get encased in POLYESTER!I think that most people would buy this dress for the fact that is advertised as a light and breezy cotton summer dress. Why in the world would they decide to ruin it and add the enormous amount of polyester lining?? The entire dress is lined with the polyester on the inside and when you put it on, all you'll feel is sticky hot plastic. It completelly undoes the outside cotton fabric and feel.Initially I thought I could just cut out the lining and wear it without, but it has the see-through lines and design on it so it would be tough to wear without showing some skin underneath. So I ended up returning this one.Other than the polyester issue, the dress is well made, beautiful true (as in pics) green color, good length for my 5"8 frame. Sleeves are nice length, they sit flat, and arm openings are right size where they don't show the undergarments but they don't suffocate either.Also the waist is not too tight and it makes it comfortable to wear. This is a particularly flattering fit for apple shape bodies if you get the right size. I did size up on mine because I wanted more room in the chest and that was a good choice.I really wanted to like and keep this dress for all the above reasons hence the 3 stars, but unfortunately just can't come to terms with the ugly lining. If this was just a plain cotton fabric on the outside without the see-through lines, it could have been worn without the lining and would have been really versatile beautiful summer dress.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Short, busty girls of the world, rejoice!
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: This is my Goldilocks dress - JUST RIGHT! I am 5’0”, 40-33-40 and Amazon recommended a large. This is the perfect work dress for me as a teacher. Bought one and threw it on after some sprays of Downey wrinkle release for the vacuum sealed wrinkles and was out the door in 5 minutes.Wore it for a hour and then literally ordered 6 more in different colors for about $100! So cheap, but doesn’t look it. And because I live in SoCal, I can wear it year round by layering.No lining and no pockets, but that’s better for the weather here anyway. And the material just slinks over your body, thick enough to not show any lumps and bumps, but thin enough to not be hot.The top fits correctly, and the darting allows it to hug the girls without leaving gaping holes in the armpit. The waist was loose enough to move comfortably, but fitted enough to not look like a sack. The bottom was a loose enough to not show any VPL, but not a swing or trapeze shape.It’s the perfect length on me. I’m so short that most “short” dresses go past my knee, but this one is right above it. When you sit, it will ride up, and the slit on the side will go higher, so it may be more of a tunic length for you taller ladies, but won’t be indecent if you wear bike shorts under them just in case the slit rides too high.For summer, I threw on some sandals. For work, I can throw some heels on for big presentations, or wear sneakers for running around and still look professional while being comfortable and still able to get down on the ground, if needed.Most of the colors are discounted right now, so my fellow professional shorties- scoop them up now before they realize what they have!UPDATE- the dress is still awesome. I’ve gotten several compliments. Navy and black are my favorites. I ended up returning the lighter colors I got. The dresses were cut exactly the same, but the colors didn’t looks right on my complexion and some had a shine to them that was more obvious on the lighter colors that made the material look cheaper, and the seams more visible.I still highly recommend them in darker colors.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: This dress will make your summer!!!This dress will make your summer!!!
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I absolutely adore these sundresses, and have purchased them in multiple color/patterns. This is a summer must-have!FABRIC/QUALITY: The dress is well made. The fabric is opaque, of excellent quality, and doesn’t wrinkle. I’ve traveled with these and they came out of the suitcase wrinkle-free. They’re a soft, elevated t-shirt material (but also with some stretch). I wash on delicate and hang to dry, dries overnight, comes out looking perfect. Even after multiple washings they continue to look good as new—no shrinkage or fading.FIT/STYLE: Feminine, comfortable, effortless, and flowy. It defines the bust, cinches the waist, and flows into a universally flattering, a-line shape. I wear a half-tee under mine because I’m 63 and a modest dresser, but that’s just me. Dress them up or down as you wish. I’m 5’5”, 115-117 pounds, 34B, 34-27-37 (pear shape body type) and wearing a size medium. I could’ve definitely gone with the small for a closer fit in the body, but it was too short for comfort on me. If you’re like me and love boho/cottage core styles, or want the simplicity of putting on a dress as a one-and-done, ready for the day— then you’ll want to add this one to your collection.These dresses are incredibly soft, comfortable, and ideal for our coastal, subtropical southern summers. I wear mine to lunches and daytime outings with friends, errands, appointments, and casual dinners out with my husband. A wonderful elevated alternative to shorts. I just add simple stud earrings, possibly a delicate necklace, my trainers, and whatever handbag fits my activities for the day.I’m not compensated in any way for my reviews. I  write them because I rely on them myself when shopping online. I hope this review is helpful. Have a wonderful day!

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Cute dress. Perfect sized. I got an XXL.I’m 5”10 about 240-250lbs. I have long legs and a long torso. Sits perfectly on my waste and it Comes down to my knees which is perfect for the office or out with clients. I do wear a tank top or one of those things you snap onto your bra to make it look like a shirt is underneath so it shows less cleavage (when at work)It’s also perfect for going out in whether to dinner or drinks.  I like that it covers my upper arms. It’s not tight so it’s very  comfortable. Fabric seems decent and I haven’t had any issues yet.I’ve washed it 2-3 times so far but hung up to dry. ( I never put any clothes in the dryer)No pilling and no shrinkage so far. I do wash this in warm/cold cycle and in a laundry bag to avoid pilling and other fabrics from sticking to it. I might purchase in other colors. Price wasn’t too bad either. I’d buy again and I recommend getting this.Lastly, you can dress this up with a nice pair of heals or dressy shoes or wear with flats or flip flops. Either way will look nice.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Very nice little summer dressVery nice little summer dress
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I just like this dress, period. I'm 5' 4" and about 135 lbs, and the medium size fit me perfectly. It has usable pockets on both sides. The A-line fit is flattering and the hem is just barely above my knees (I am kind of short though). I'm large in the chest (36DD) and work out a lot so have unusually big shoulders and upper arms, but the torso and sleeves on this dress also fit fine.In terms of fabric thickness and opacity, no worries there. No translucence that I could detect. The general quality of the dress is good, and I think for the price I have a dress I'll be wearing quite frequently. It looks to me like gentle wash and dry will work for it, too.In terms of what types of scenarios this would be suitable for? Almost anything short of formal. You could layer it with a cardigan or blazer. Add a belt (I will be). Accessorize with hosiery and/or jewelry. And while in my opinion the red and white flower print is eye-catching, neither is it overdone or garish. Just a plain, easy-to-wear dress suitable for daily were.My only proviso might be that during windy days, one might opt for a half-slip. Nevertheless, a great dress, which I got at a very good price (on sale).

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Update to my review below. I ordered the black and the lighter blue dress in a size XL and they fit nice, the stitching was the same color as the fabric and the fabric was the same color inside and out.  I also expanded the picture for the floral green dress and it appears to have green stitching. However, the constant inconsistencies I've  inexperienced here prevents from getting the green floral dress as it may arrive with the white stitching. Since I'm happy with the other dresses, I'm upgrading my review to 4 stars.I ordered two of these dresses. One green in size L and one red in the size XL.  For reference, I am 40D, 5'6 and 169lbs.  The dresses are a tad above my knee cap so perfect for me.The reason for the different sizes ordered is because I ordered the red one with flowers first in the size L about a year or so ago from a different company through Amazon called Fensace.  The fit was snug around the bust area and I had to wear a safety pin so that it would not look too sexy for work.  However I loved the dress. I thought this was the same company when I made the recent order.So with this company, Rumia, I ordered the red in XL. Same exact dress, but when I tried it on the dress was loose. I decided to keep it for work and use the other one for going out and about.  So I give the red dress 5 stars. It also came with a little flower clip so that you can pin it close around the bust line.I then decided to order the green dress in a size L because I loved the green print with the large white flowers. The pattern was very pretty and the fit was really nice, but I could not get past how cheap it looked, especially with white stitching compared to the red dress.  I believe it's because the red dress is full of little white flowers so it hides the stitching and the green dress has more green material because the flowers are big and strategically placed. So one could see the white stitching against the green material. Also, since the material is white inside, it kind of showed through if stretched, as in the bust line. So if you have a snug fit anywhere, the white will show. There was also thread hanging from it. I would not even use it for running errands or for being out and about. So I returned it.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Versatile, cute dress. FITS WELL (follow their size chart)
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Very cute, comfortable dress. This is a very soft and stretchy, lightweight fabric, and they included a little "extra" pair of pins to fasten the neckline, which I really appreciate! Although it is a polyester, rayon, spandex blend, it is not too hot for warm weather (I am wearing it during a record heat wave in Southern California!)I ordered the size M in alignment with their size chart. I normally wear a size small or 6 dress, but the medium fits perfectly. Just-above-the-knee length, flattering v-neckline and flutter sleeves. Perfect to pull on and go. You can wear it with tennis shoes or flip flops for casual wear, dress it up with a heel and jewelry. Very versatile, it would work for casual wear, errands, church, work, dinner out, or a dressy event, depending on how you accessorize.I bought it in hot pink and will probably buy more colors!

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: For just north of $20, this was a great find! I am 5'5.5" tall, about 132 pounds, 32DD - lean, athletic build. I purchased this in both the size small and size medium, but kept the small. The medium ended up being a bit too loose in the chest and had some extra material on one side of the hips (maybe a manufacturing flaw here). The small fit a bit more snuggly around the narrowest part of my waistline, completely covered the girls with no extra material and did not have any odd material fold on the hip area.I am quite long in the torso and the narrowest part of my waist lives right under my bust, so the waistline of this dress rides a bit higher on me than on the model, but I like it.  And again, even though I am a 32DD, I have no cleavage exposure and the v-neck stays closed without the modesty clips (although they are super cute). I like the sleeves on this dress. They are longer than cap sleeves (thank goodness), but not so long that they look frumpy. They hit at a perfect spot on the upper arm.The material is light enough for summer in the south and reminds me of a combo of jersey tee and slinky. It's not the best quality, but the dress is also $20ish.Wrap dresses (including mock ones like this) are incredibly flattering on just about all body types and this one is no exception.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Great quality and fit, but color is pink rather than purple
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: ​I am overall very pleased with this dress. The material feels high quality, and the fit is really lovely and flattering.​The only reason I am deducting one star is due to the color accuracy. I ordered the "Plain Purple" option, but in person, the shade is actually a light pastel pink—just a shade darker than baby pink. I checked with several people to make sure it wasn't just my lighting, and everyone agreed that the dress is definitely pink rather than purple.​If the color had matched the listing description, this would easily be a 5-star product. If you don't mind receiving a light pink dress instead of purple, I highly recommend it for its quality and fit!

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I bought this as a kind of summer “house dress” because I wanted something that felt easy without being frumpy that wasn’t made of plastic and that I wouldn’t be self conscious to walk my dog in.And so far so good! It’s flowy, breathable, and I like the color. It’s also true to size, I didn’t have to size up to get the same relaxed fit that the model has.I know some reviews have said that it’s too translucent, but in this color I feel reasonably well covered. I’m sure that in the right light my silhouette would be perceived, but as I ordered this for very casual wear I don’t mind, I like that it feels light.In my mind the only thing really missing here is pockets. productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I’m 5’5”, 200 lbs., apple shaped, and 68 years old.In spite of its content, the material feels very comfortable against my skin. I wear beige colored underwear and found it’s not see-through at all. The slight stretchiness is great. The deep pockets make it a joy. A few days ago, it was 108°F here. This dress was the only thing I could bear to put on.At its longest point, the dress hits me halfway between mid-calves and my ankles. Long for a midi, but not a maxi. Feels comfortably midi because of the uneven hem. When the wind blows, it moves beautifully. The straps are wide and I have no worries about bra straps showing. The dress slips on over my head so it’s very easy to get in to. With a light sweater, it can take me into Fall. At my age, I can feel stylish in this, but not like “mutton dressed as lamb.”I prefer a loose fit because of personal preference. I just can’t stand it when things are tight. I’m also a breast cancer survivor. I had a lumpectomy so one of my girls is noticeably smaller than the other. This doesn’t bother me about 98% of the time—glad to still be here 20 years later, you know?—but I don’t need to advertise it either, so I often go a size up. I didn’t need to with this. My chest is 48” and XXXL feels perfect. The manufacturer recommends XXXL for 49.3” chests and XXL for 45.7”.The fit looks slimming to me, even as “fluffy” as I am. It’s in the cut. The straight cut through the waist flares gently to an A-line that’s not overly exaggerated. It’s just a smooth clean line. Nothing dramatic.I am questioning the rustic style of the buttons, however, and am glad one reviewer said she cut hers off. I sometimes wear long necklaces and the buttons interrupt how they hang. In and of themselves, they don’t bother me in the slightest, but if the dress was a solid color I’d definitely be removing them.I really adore this dress. It’s all the right things in all the right ways and makes me feel very feminine. I will be buying at least two more. I can’t recommend it highly enough. I hope this helps.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Great quality and value in all aspects
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: This dress is exactly as described and pictured. The colors are vibrant and there are enough colors that you’ll have no problem matching shoes. The  material is a soft blend of 95% polyester and 5% spandex and has some stretch.  It is NOT clingy and the material is NOT shiny or heavy.  It is NOT see through. The fit is true to Amazon’s recommendation (XXL) and fits beautifully.  The pockets are hidden side slits so there’s no interruption of the pattern. The 3 buttons at the top are decorative only, so there’s no worry of gapping.  The vertical stripe is slimming and disguises my belly. The shirt tail length is past my knees which I like and because it’s slightly shorter on the sides, it has a nice flow and swing when I walk.  My racer back bra straps were mostly hidden but showed a tiny bit at the arm holes. I plan to wear a navy tank with a built in bra so I’m not constantly worrying about my own stupid bra.  As an added bonus, it was wrinkle free right out of the bag and had no weird smells at all. This is listed as a summer dress but it can easily be worn year round with a light sweater in spring and fall, as is, in the summer and a cardigan and boots will take it through winter.  This is an all occasion dress, excluding formal.  I highly recommend this dress.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: For just north of $20, this was a great find! I am 5'5.5" tall, about 132 pounds, 32DD - lean, athletic build. I purchased this in both the size small and size medium, but kept the small. The medium ended up being a bit too loose in the chest and had some extra material on one side of the hips (maybe a manufacturing flaw here). The small fit a bit more snuggly around the narrowest part of my waistline, completely covered the girls with no extra material and did not have any odd material fold on the hip area.I am quite long in the torso and the narrowest part of my waist lives right under my bust, so the waistline of this dress rides a bit higher on me than on the model, but I like it.  And again, even though I am a 32DD, I have no cleavage exposure and the v-neck stays closed without the modesty clips (although they are super cute). I like the sleeves on this dress. They are longer than cap sleeves (thank goodness), but not so long that they look frumpy. They hit at a perfect spot on the upper arm.The material is light enough for summer in the south and reminds me of a combo of jersey tee and slinky. It's not the best quality, but the dress is also $20ish.Wrap dresses (including mock ones like this) are incredibly flattering on just about all body types and this one is no exception.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Update to my review below. I ordered the black and the lighter blue dress in a size XL and they fit nice, the stitching was the same color as the fabric and the fabric was the same color inside and out.  I also expanded the picture for the floral green dress and it appears to have green stitching. However, the constant inconsistencies I've  inexperienced here prevents from getting the green floral dress as it may arrive with the white stitching. Since I'm happy with the other dresses, I'm upgrading my review to 4 stars.I ordered two of these dresses. One green in size L and one red in the size XL.  For reference, I am 40D, 5'6 and 169lbs.  The dresses are a tad above my knee cap so perfect for me.The reason for the different sizes ordered is because I ordered the red one with flowers first in the size L about a year or so ago from a different company through Amazon called Fensace.  The fit was snug around the bust area and I had to wear a safety pin so that it would not look too sexy for work.  However I loved the dress. I thought this was the same company when I made the recent order.So with this company, Rumia, I ordered the red in XL. Same exact dress, but when I tried it on the dress was loose. I decided to keep it for work and use the other one for going out and about.  So I give the red dress 5 stars. It also came with a little flower clip so that you can pin it close around the bust line.I then decided to order the green dress in a size L because I loved the green print with the large white flowers. The pattern was very pretty and the fit was really nice, but I could not get past how cheap it looked, especially with white stitching compared to the red dress.  I believe it's because the red dress is full of little white flowers so it hides the stitching and the green dress has more green material because the flowers are big and strategically placed. So one could see the white stitching against the green material. Also, since the material is white inside, it kind of showed through if stretched, as in the bust line. So if you have a snug fit anywhere, the white will show. There was also thread hanging from it. I would not even use it for running errands or for being out and about. So I returned it.

Yeokou is a comfortable apparel brand founded in 2017, specializing in women's, men's and kid's casual wear.

Yeokou is not about fast-changing trends. We are about consistent, honest comfort for everyday moments.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: So far so good.  Nice fit and workmanship
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Lots of compliments and made me feel good wearing it.  This is the kind of style that’s almost universally chic for every body type, although I am very long-waisted and wish the waist went lower. The dreaded gap at the bust did not happen and I’m a D.  Didn’t gap anywhere else so a slip on a hot summer day wasn’t necessary.  Workmanship looks good with very few loose threads. Seams were flat and good. Buttonholes were functional and well done. We’ll see how the sizing (fabric finish) looks after laundering and if it bleeds color. productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I actually really liked this dress overall. The style is cute, flattering, and easy to throw on for everyday wear. I'm 5'10", and this definitely did not hit at a maxi length on me. It landed in an awkward spot on my shins that I didn't find very flattering. I actually ended up giving it to my mom, who is shorter, and it looked much better on her.Overall: cute, comfortable dress with a flattering fit, but if you're taller, just be aware that the length may not be what you're expecting.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Gorgeous rich color and beautiful tailored fit, but note: the waist has NO stretch!Gorgeous rich color and beautiful tailored fit, but note: the waist has NO stretch!
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: This dress was great-- flattered the right areas and hid the ones I don't love! It feels much softer than your average structured cotton button-down, keeping the crisp, clean look of a traditional button-up shirt but has a lighter, smoother drape to it. It doesn't feel stiff against the skin at all. The design and shape are incredibly flattering. I especially love how the short sleeves are cut—with great upper-arm coverage while still breezy. The midi length hits perfectly below the knee, making it something you could dress up or down.The cinched, pleated details around the waist give it a beautiful, tailored shape, but be warned... the waist is not elastic. There is very little give or stretch in that area, so you'll want to keep that in mind when choosing your size. Additionally, there are quite a few buttons down the front, and they can be a bit tedious to do up—but the final look is absolutely worth the extra effort!

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: My order arrived on time, but unfortunately, it was a return, all crumpled up in an amazon plastic bag. All the buttons were undone, 1st sign of it being a return. I put it on, started buttoning from the bottom. By the time I got to the 6th button, I was having difficulty pushing the button through the hole. I though the issue was on my end, but upon closer inspection, it turns out the hole for the button was half sewn closed, so the button would never fit through at all. I then checked the 7th button, the same, 8th button... the same... So, this will be a definite return and will be re-purchasing another one in black. Hopefully, it will be new and not another returned item.I tried on the green version of the same dress. Luckily, this was one was still in the original bag from the seller. I purchased a Medium. I'm 5' 1", at 150lbs, athletic build. The Medium fit snug, but not too tight around the waist. The length of the dress fell mid-calf on me. I could try on a Large, but I'm afraid it will be too wide in the midsection and not be snug enough to give you that corset look.The fabric is light and airy, similar to that of men's button down collared suit shirts. I tend to sweat a lot, so the darker color black could easily hide the perspiration. I'm not so sure about the light colored dresses. The sweat "may" show through the fabric. I purchased the green, but will not be using it for an outdoor summer event, for fear of running into that issue. I will be wearing the black for an outdoor event, and the green one for an indoor event.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I really wanted to love this dress, but it has two major problems: first of all, the sizing. I am a 28" waist and ordered the XS, and it was huge. Secondly, the  material itself feels very cheap (which, yes, I know you get what you pay for), but it feels plastic-y to the point that it reminded me of the big parachute we used to use in gym class as kids. aPlusContent.rawText:
Product description
Missufe Women's Ruched Casual Sundress Knee Legnth Bodycon Sheath T Shirt Dress 
Description 
This is a ruched bodycon dress feature with round neck / knee length / side shirring / short sleeve / solid color / slim fit.
It is a basic style, making you chic and beautiful, fashionable and elegant.
Our fabric is really skin-friendly and comfortable to wear, you will love it the first time you dress in. Thanks to the elastic fabric and ruched design, no matter what body shape you are in, this dress can give you a custom fit, and it's nice for pregnant in the meantime.
The sheath ruched sundress suit for spring / summer / autumn, you can match it with high heels, flats, sandals, underarm bags, sunglasses.
Missufe Customer Show 
Buyer Voice 
√ I was really hesitant to buy this because of how form fitted it is and because I don’t usually like ruching. But it’s very flattering and honestly it’s so comfortable that I’d keep it anyway even if it wasn’t. I am 5’5.5” and 163 lbs, with big boobs (34H) that make everything hard to fit. I got a large and it fits well. 
√ I love the way this dress fits! I have a slender, tall frame, and it is flattering to my body shape. The length is perfect, and the material is soft. 
√ I purchased this dress in white and omg... I must say I was very satisfied with the material and quality of this dress. I washed/dried and the material was still the same and I was very satisfied with that vs. other companies that I purchased this same dress from in the past and the material was thin, see through and flimsy. Very cheap looking and much more expensive, so I was very happy to see that after washing this dress that the material remained the same. Will definitely be ordering more from this company in the future. 
√ Curvy girls dream! It hugs in all the right places. I bought one in 5 different colors. It's inexpensive, lined, and incredibly flattering. I'm 5'8 and a 38G and the fit is fierce, length to mid thigh, can be dressed up or down. SOOOO universal. 
Q&A 
Q1: How about the thickness?
A1: It is regular.
Q2: How to wash this skirt, is it machine washable?
A2: Machine washable, avoid using bleach, DO NOT washing with hot water,and hang to dry.
Q3: Can it be used for maternity?
A3: Yes, the ruched bodycon dress is full of elasticity which is good for any body shape.
Q4: Does the dress shrink in the wash?
A4: No, it doesn’t shrink and recommend cold water in the wash.
Q5: I usually wear a size Large. What size should I choose?
A5: You can choose it according to normal size or one size up. Pregnant women consider choose one size up according to your waist and hips.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Love this dress! I love in California where is warm most of the year.  I was able to wear it this past Sunday to church in the middle of January with a  cardigan which I ended up having to take off due to the weather reaching 80°. I'm 6 months pregnant and was able to wear my regular size (large). I have no issues with my growing boobs as the top is very stretchy. I am currently 36 DDD/E and growing!  I would probably have to size up as I reach into months 8 & 9 and it is NOT the dress to wear for nursing due to lack of access, but the dress looks so cute with a growing belly and is extremely comfortable and light got this warmer days! The color and print and pretty especially once it's on it kind of all just comes together.  I used a tan or camel color cardigan but I can see this color work with other white or apricot.  I bought the dress in green with the small floral print.The length reached just above our around my ankles, I'm 5' 4" with a pregnant belly.  The quality is not the best but I knew that. I waited for the price to drop. Amazon now let's you price watch the past 30 & 90 days.  I wouldn't buy this dress at the regular price to be completely honest.  It washes very well.  I hang it up to dry so it releases any wrinkles and it's pretty much ready to wear.  Again,  the value is there if you wait for the price to drop. I usually add it to a wish list or save for later option and check.Overall,  I think this dress will fit any body type and size!

I'm very pale and self-conscious of my upper arms, so I like the floaty short sleeve. I don't like restrictive clothing so the fit through chest and shoulders is much appreciated. productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Cute cheap $20 dress with the quality you'd expect from a $20 dressCute cheap $20 dress with the quality you'd expect from a $20 dress
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I bought this dress for casual wear for $23.72. I got a size M, and it fits me. Biggest complaint is the the fabric is flimsy and pills easily. I carried a cross body gym bag that was about 10 lb / 5 kg for less than 10 minutes and the fabric under the dress was already damaged. The label says this fabric is 90% polyester and 10% spandex. Care instructions say max temperature of 30 deg C, do not bleach, iron on low heat, do not tumble dry, hang dry.The shape and quality of sewing is as expected for a dress at this price. There isn't much structure in the top half of the dress and the weight of the skirt can awkwardly pull on the waist. The torso is a bit long for me so the waist can be uncomfortable. The pockets are functional and can fit a phone and wallet. I've worn this dress 4 times and the threads on the buttons are already coming loose. The buttons don't have any functional purpose so it's fine if they're loose but it looks messy.The pattern is cute and the colors mostly match the product picture. The colors haven't faded after 5 washes and there wasn't any color bleeding when I presoaked my dress. The problem is that I have a faint white stripe across my chest from the damage from carrying that bag. This dress isn't very durable so I'll save it for casual wear when I don't have to carry anything heavier than a small purse.

Any bigger and the dress would not fit. The waist is like an empire waist on me. That means taller people with a long torso may have difficulty with this dress. For me, it's perfect in the torso and the dress fits me like a glove.The dress is lined, and not see through at all. The fabric is good quality, soft, and breathable. It does need ironing since it's cotton but it's quite simple to iron. The dress hits above my knees, and the placket in the front conceals cleavage but still elongates the neck and chest area, which is always good for petite women. This is a lovely dress for work and for summer.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Love this summer dress - classy and cute, sizing is as described
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I bought this dress in Medium size and Navy in color. It fits perfectly, and the dress is as described and shown in the product photos. It also has pockets!Regarding sizing, my height is 5'4" and weight is 120 pounds, my measurements are 36 bust, 26.5 waist, and 36 hips. I could have gone with Small according to the sizing chart, but I made the right decision to go with Medium rather than Small for vanity reasons haha.The Medium fits very well -- it's comfortable, nothing is too tight, and the dress is flowy and hits my knees. I had decided that if the Medium was too big around the waist, I could always pinch it smaller, but a dress that's too tight around my waist (or too short, like at my thighs) would have to be returned. I haven't needed to pinch it smaller; this dress's stretchy waist band sits right at my natural waist and it fits just right.The skirt has a liner (in the same color as the rest of the dress), so there are no concerns about the dress being see-through. The fabric pattern is really pretty. There are no zippers; you just pull the dress over your head.This dress is cute, feminine, and flirty, and also simultaneously modest and classy. I love how it looks and feels on me, and I can't wait to wear this throughout the hot summer! Highly recommend this one!

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I bought the blue/black flowers pattern for a wedding. It's gorgeous. the only thing, it's way too long, about 6" too long for my height. I would definitely purchase it again in other colors.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I bought the English Rose Petite dress for a tea party and absolutely loved it! It’s very forgiving and flattering, especially for a mom body. The adjustable shoulder straps are a great feature, and the straps are thick enough that I can comfortably wear a regular bra. The fabric isn’t cotton, but it’s soft, lightweight, and flowy, almost like cotton. Overall, it’s a beautiful and comfortable dress that I’m very happy with.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I love this dress with one small exception.  The dress is extremely flattering. I love the adjustable ties in the bust area. productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I really wanted to love this dress it has 3 features that set it apart from other milkmaid style dresses that made me want to love it1. The gorgeous dark floral2. POCKETS3. The ties on the bust actually run through the top of the fabric and can adjust the ruching where many other dresses they are just strings at the end that tie things closes and the ruching is not adjustable.But then there were a few big misses on this dress that ultimately I decided were too much for me to fix or deal with to keep it.1. It only comes in a small (4-6) and I’m more of a xs (0-2) it was really just too big and there was no smaller size option. I am about 5’ 115lbs with a 27in waist and the back was loose and gaping where the elastic is. I could stretch it away front my body a good 6 inches.2. There is no lace up back just a stretchy elastic. While this might be more comfortable it doesn’t give that snatched corset look and really doesn’t make this a corset dress. If this dress had the lacing it might have worked better sizing wise for me because at least I could have brought it in a few inches around the waist.3. There is no boning in the seaming on the front. I suppose if you aren’t going to put the laces in then you don’t really need boning either, but the structure makes no these types of dresses look so much more crisp and fitted4. There is no side slit, more of a personal preference and I could add one, but lots of extra work5. Im short and the hem hit at an awkward ankle level rather than the normal tea length or midi length. I would have needed to hem it.I’m really sad this dress didn’t work for me. I love the print and silhouette. I think on someone a little bigger and who doesn’t care about lacing up it will be perfect.If scarlet darkness improved on this design and added the back lacing and expanded sizing I would 100% keep this dress.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Probably best for someone of average bust size
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Bought this (and a yellow one) for a trip to Italy. The dresses are comfy and lightweight. Beautiful. And easy to wear with sandals or flat to dress them up or down for the occasion. The skirt is flown and the sizing is accurate. I bought my normal size and it fit perfectly. Fabric is breathable.My only complaint is this: Im busty. (36H) and after 2 kids I need a little support in the bust. The cut of the upper portion is beautiful on the hanger, but due to the low "neckline" wearing a bra is impossible with this dress. Now, with it being fitted through the abdomen area and the gathered/high "waist", I could/should have been able to wear this without a bra. BUT the gathered area is a bit deceiving. The pleats are only across the front/middle area of the bust. From the side (underarm) area theres about 3 inches of flat, no give, straight on fabric that pushes your (my) "girls" straight out infrint of me. 🤣 this leaves you (me) with a very strange looking profile, and a bust that looks like you've sat the girls on some sort of shelf.From the front everything looks normal, but that profile is WONKY. If you have a more average/standard bust (or smaller) this dress would probably be AMAZING on you. But on me it was a bit strange.Im going to keep it as im currently working on losing a bit of weight and im hoping the "girls" will shrink just enough to make this work.
productPageReviews.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on July 19, 2025
productPageReviews.variant: Size: Large, Color: White Blue Floral

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: This dress is absolutely beautiful! It is my new favorite dress! The fabric is perfect, the fit is nearly perfectly (as if custom made), it seems to have high quality stitching and such so I won't have to worry about a child tugging on my dress and ripping a strap off. The pockets are a cool feature but ride a bit high for my long arms. I don't know if they'll survive the beating this dress will likely get with all the rocks and things that somehow end up in my pockets (busy family). I'll try to be easy on them. I would buy 10 more of these in different colors and patterns right now if I could. It's absolutely beautiful and practically wrinkle free right out of the package. Don't ask how they did that! It's incredibly feminine and soft and flowy and provides a nice shape around the bosom. I imagine it'd be very forgiving around the tummy area for anyone post partum or thick around the middle due to the pretty gathering of the fabric. It's very flattering. Buying clothes online is always a risk. But not this time! I am very thankful!

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Fits true to size, definitely will get it in more colorsFits true to size, definitely will get it in more colors
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: This dress is perfect and my toddler said I look like a princess so I’m gonna buy it again in different colors lol. I am 5’2 , 225lbs bust G cup and I wear a 2X. The 2X from this brand fit perfect as you can see from the photo. It’s not too tight, It’s not too loose, I was surprised at how well it fits honestly and how I don’t have to do any adjusting. I have always been insecure about my arms so I put a lace undershirt under it and it does not squeeze and show the undershirt through the fabric. It has pockets! Love that.As for cleaning I just washed it in the washer in cold water on delicate and low heat/delicate in the dryer and it was just fine. It is mainly polyester so it’s a slick material feel so definitely don’t expect a cotton feel but it feels lightweight and that it will be great for spring and summer.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Gorgeous silhouette, but keep an eye on the straps!Gorgeous silhouette, but keep an eye on the straps!
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: This dress is absolutely beautiful and feels wonderful on. The double lining is a huge plus.  You don't have to worry about undergarments showing through at all, which is rare for lighter colors! The fit is very flattering and feminine.The only reason I’m giving it 4 stars instead of 5 is the material. It’s very silky, which feels nice against the skin, but it makes the hardware on the adjustable straps slide VERY easily. I found myself having to readjust them frequently throughout the day. Also, the front tie element comes undone easily due to the silkiness, so you have to tie it quite tight to keep it secure. Overall, it's a great dress, just requires a little maintenance while wearing!

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: These little dresses are super cute! I’ve purchased 8 or 9 so far and they’re all identically cut and sized. I’m 5’6.5” & 144 pounds. The Medium is a bit snug around the ribcage and none so far are very stretchy although they do give. But pulling them off especially with a damp swimsuit underneath is a challenge but it’s the best size for me. Yes, they’re somewhat sheer. The material is average but these are all features and not flaws because most style descriptors say they’re “beach coverups” and nothing more. Still, I run errands in them and bebop around the neighborhood. We’re on the Southern California coast, so it’s a normal way to dress. For our midwestern and conservative area folks, I can give you reasons to not pass up these cute dresses. It’s generally too hot in the summer and early fall. We’re months from cooler weather. On sale, prices are usually fairly decent. And they truly are flattering and not too short (IMO). I am pleased that they’re not pilling and that I can throw on a cardigan if we go out for lunch. The stitching is great on this very simple pattern. I like where the pockets land. For me, not at all in front. They start at the side seam, so how they’d land in front is a mystery. Although they’re not particularly wrinkly, I did have to steam them after the initial washing but once I did they don’t wrinkle in subsequent washes. Not all are colorfast, so wash individually until you know for sure. Definitely recommend!

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Perfect,  if you are looking for a nightgown
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: If this were being sold as a nightgown, I would give it five stars. But since it is being sold as a dress, I feel compelled to give it only three stars. It isn't absolutely terrible, and I've seen some terrible things from Amazon, but at least for this particular version of this dress (green with tan stripes down the middle and flowers  on one side at at the bottom),  it's definitely more on the sleep dress side of things.Fit: It is a little loose, but I think a size down would be too tight for my apple shape (heavy in the mid section, 5'9" and 190lbs normally an XL). It hits me just above the knee so a good length.Material: is not really dressy material. It's very light and soft, with absolutely zero structure.  The pockets have an odd placement. They are on the outside of the dress and hit me just at my hips. Yet another thing that makes it seem less dressy.Since I only paid $13.49 for it I am going to keep it and wear it as a nightgown. I can't get a nightgown on Amazon this cheap, and it is really comfy.Look, I think I have pretty realistic expectations of clothing on amazon. It is pretty hit or miss, and even within the same listing you will get wildly different materials, fit, and cut in different colors. Another dress in this listing might be really great, but I would just be wary of this particular style.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I had high hopes for this Silk Summer Wedding Dress, but unfortunately, it didn’t fit as expected, and I had to return it. Here’s my experience:Fabric & Quality:First, the silk material was absolutely stunning. It had a beautiful sheen and felt incredibly luxurious, which made me excited to try it on. The color was as described, and the design seemed elegant and perfect for a summer wedding. The fabric felt soft and lightweight, ideal for warm-weather events.Fit Issues:Despite following the size guide and measurements carefully, the dress did not fit well. I usually wear a size medium, so I ordered that size, but it was way too tight in the waist and loose in the bust. I had hoped for a more tailored fit, but this dress just didn’t flatter my body shape. The bodice didn’t sit correctly, and the skirt was uncomfortably snug around my hips, making it hard to move or breathe freely.Sizing Inconsistency:I’m honestly not sure if it was a sizing issue or if the dress was just poorly constructed. Even after adjusting the straps and trying different ways of cinching it, the dress just didn’t sit right. I would suggest that you size up if you’re in between sizes, or maybe even consider trying a different style altogether if you have a similar body shape to mine.Design & Comfort:While the design was elegant and simple, I did find that the dress was slightly stiff, likely due to the silk fabric. It wasn’t as comfortable as I’d hoped, especially for a wedding where you’ll be wearing it for hours. The length was fine, and the overall aesthetic was lovely, but the fit completely ruined the experience for me.Customer Service & Return:I did end up returning the dress, and the customer service process was straightforward. However, I was a little disappointed that I couldn’t find an alternative size or design that would work better for me. This dress just wasn’t for me, and unfortunately, I didn’t get the perfect summer wedding dress experience I was hoping for.Final Thoughts:While the silk fabric and design were beautiful, the fit was the dealbreaker for me. If you're thinking about buying this dress, be aware that sizing might be inconsistent, and it’s important to consider whether the cut will work for your body type. I really wanted this to be “the one,” but I had to move on and keep looking for the right dress. I’d recommend trying it on in person if possible or checking reviews from others with similar body types to get a better sense of how it fits.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: ★★★★☆ Really Cute Top, But Definitely Runs Big!I really like this top overall! The pattern is cute, the material is comfortable, and it has that nice in-between style where you can dress it up for work but still wear it casually with jeans or shorts. The cap sleeves and neckline are flattering, and it looks put together without feeling overly dressy.The biggest thing to know before ordering is that it runs BIG. I definitely would have preferred a smaller size for a more flattering fit. The extra room makes it comfortable, but it also makes the shirt look a little looser and boxier than I expected based on the pictures.Other than the sizing, I really don't have any complaints. It's lightweight enough for warmer weather, comfortable to wear for an entire workday, and easy to pair with different pants or accessories. I especially like having tops like this that look professional enough for work without feeling stiff or uncomfortable.I'm giving it four stars because I genuinely like the shirt, but the sizing could be more accurate. If you're between sizes or prefer your tops a little more fitted, I would recommend sizing down.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Good fit, cute, casual or accessorize to dress up.
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Very cute dress. Lightweight, soft and thin, jersey-like, t-shirt material. Love the v-neck and the way the sleeves lay on the shoulders. Pockets are fun.I am 5' 2" (short) and the length is good, just above the knee. I weigh 194 lbs, full chested and big belly. I tried both the XL and XXL.The XL fit okay but slightly clung to my belly. The XXL is just perfect...not too big.I bought the black which is what I wear most. I wish there was more solid colors.I also got the red with white floral which was cute, but I returned because red just is not my color.
productPageReviews.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on August 15, 2026

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: This is such a cute summer dress! It falls at the right spot of my thigh (not too short, not too long) and is super soft material. Love the pockets! The material did not seem too thin, either (i.e., doesn't appear to be see-through). I think this dress is extremely versatile - could be worn to a casual dinner location, running errands during the day, changing into after work for hanging around the house, or even as a bathing suit cover up. I hang mine to dry after washing just to make sure it doesn't shrink in size (but then again, I hang dry most of my clothes anyway).
productPageReviews.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on July 2, 2026

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Not feeling thin? Stripes for the win!Not feeling thin? Stripes for the win!
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I ordered this pattern and the solid green. I looked at the size chart and sized down. What a difference between the two! The green feels way too big--especially too long--on me.  I am 5'0, so it is difficult for me to find dresses that are not an awkward length. I would prefer an inch or two shorter, but such is the plight of the petite (especially those of us with large chest size). For reference, I am 132 lbs and wear size 36 D bra. This dress hits me just above the knee, and looks much more flattering in stripes than single color. The green seems to show every curve and bulge. I will keep this one, even though the fit is not exactly right. The material is soft, stretchy, and comfortable. It might be a bit thin--enough so that I would hesitate to buy lighter colors.
productPageReviews.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on July 1, 2026Reviewed in the United States on July 1, 2026

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Great Material and Color, but the Fit Wasn’t for Me
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I really wanted to love this dress, especially because the pink color is beautiful and vibrant. The material is also great, nice, thick, and feels like good quality.Unfortunately, I ended up returning it because of the fit. From the waist down, the dress falls too straight and didn’t give me the more flattering, defined silhouette I was expecting based on the photos. I think it would look much more stylish if the waist area were more accentuated and then flowed naturally from there.The quality and color were definitely positives, but unfortunately, I just didn’t like how the overall shape looked on me.
productPageReviews.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on August 11, 2026

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Love this summer dress. The pattern looks great., the fabric is soft and light for hot weather in the South Texas summer. The first day I wore this dress received compliments on where did you get this dress.  I opened up my Amazon app and  shared the link with them to order the dress. . I told the ladies I that it comes in different colors and they told me they don’t I want any other pattern  but the stripes. . The pattern is really pretty.I will add  that I later ordered Petite Kristy hat from Wallaroo company out of Australia.  Color in Ivory/Stone. It is perfect for summer and compliments this dress. Sorry I didn’t take pictures when I wore  them both.
productPageReviews.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on August 20, 2026

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I got the apricot flowers and while I love the dress, I feel like the color is more in the red spectrum. Many compliments and fits well. I am 5'2 and 150 and got the medium. I may shorten it as it falls right at my knees. and was hoping for a bit shorter as shown in the pictures.
productPageReviews.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on August 21, 2026

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Darling Dress but Only Suitable for Wearing at Home
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Very comfortable, cute dress. Love the stripes and pretty colors. However, the stripes are not matched at the seams and, therefore, the dress can only be worn at home or to extremely casual outings. The price reflects this - lack of attention to detail in matching the stripes - b/c it is such an inexpensive product. A more expensive dress would certainly have matched stripes. You get what you pay for! The dress is so comfortable and the fabric is incredibly soft and I enjoy wearing it. I just wish that it were better-made so I could wear it outside the home.
productPageReviews.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on July 21, 2026

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Quality material / fabric, pretty bright colors, perfect neckline for a church dress. Love the length, great summer dress. It is loose fitting, but that’s what I wanted. It will look so cute at the beach. I ordered blue and white- love the colors and got tons of compliments last week when I wore it. I could have fit in a medium, but I’m happy with the large.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Perfect flattering cut and style for this dress, as well as the weight of the fabric.It drapes nicely. It is very flattering and would hide some imperfections to the body at the same time being very comfortable and lightweight. It is not see through at all.And with a nice slit that goes up the side, it makes it comfortable to sit in or to shop in or to lounge around in and still get around And feel casual, or it could easily be dressed up with nice shoes and a handbag.One thing I didn't like about it was that the neck was too high for me.And so I just cut a five inch slit straight down from the center of the collar, and the fabric did not unravel or anything.It just gave it a nice little bit of gap for me against the skin where if i'm wearing a summer necklace, you can see that right there at the center of the collarbone Area. so for me, it was easy fix to my only concern about this dress. It looks as though it will pack nicely.It doesn't seem to wrinkle because it came right out of the package with no wrinkles at all. I think this will pack very nicely for travel as well as having an extra comfy And pretty outfit to change into during weekly errands and after work. I would definitely recommend this dress.And it was true to size and not overly bulky, but just a little bit loose enough to be flattering, but yet still have a nice pretty shape.

Please Refer To Our Size Chart Carefully 
How does this dress fit? Is it true to size? 
It runs true to size. The dress is looser around the waist, hips and tummy and not body‑hugging. If you’re between sizes and want a more fitted look, choose one size down; if you prefer extra room in the bust or shoulders, size up. 
What is the fabric like? Is it soft and breathable for summer? 
The dress is made from a lightweight woven fabric that feels smooth and soft on the skin. It’s breathable and flowy, great for spring and summer. The loose fit and short sleeves allow air to circulate so it doesn’t feel stuffy. 
Is the fabric stretchy? Will it feel tight when I sit or move? 
The fabric itself has little to no stretch, but the relaxed cut gives plenty of room in the waist and hips, so it should not feel tight for most customers when walking or sitting. 
How do I wash and care for this dress? 
For best results, turn it inside out, machine wash on a gentle cycle in cold water, and hang or lay flat to dry. Avoid bleach and high‑heat drying to protect the color and floral print. If needed, use a cool iron or steamer on the reverse side. 
What occasions is this boho floral dress suitable for? 
It’s very versatile—perfect for daily wear, brunch, shopping, vacations, beach trips, baby showers, picnics, and casual dates. With wedges and simple jewelry, it also works for casual Fridays at the office or garden parties.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Soft, Breathable Dress with a Quietly Premium FeelSoft, Breathable Dress with a Quietly Premium Feel
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: This dress exceeded my expectations. The material is a 45% cotton, 42% viscose, 13% polyamide blend, soft, breathable, and lightweight with a smooth, easy drape that gives it a quietly premium feel.  It’s comfortable in warm weather and fully opaque — no issues with show‑through, and any undergarment color works.I ordered my usual size, and the fit is relaxed without being shapeless.  The A‑line silhouette is loose and breezy but doesn’t make me feel oversized; it keeps a clean line and moves well. The length is on the longer side of short, which makes it easy to wear without feeling too bare.The puff sleeves are on‑trend and add a soft, feminine touch, and the elastic cuffs have plenty of stretch.  The contrasting trim around the V‑neck and cuffs gives the dress character and elevates the overall look, making it feel more intentional than a basic summer dress.The craftsmanship is solid, the fabric feels good against the skin, and the overall style is versatile enough for casual outings, errands, or a relaxed dinner.  Care is simple — machine wash cold; I’ll line dry mine to help preserve the fabric and drape.Overall, this is a comfortable, flattering, and well‑designed dress at a very fair price.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: So cute but must own an iron!So cute but must own an iron!
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Such an adorable dress. I ordered this outfit to try for a friends photo shoot . I am 150lbs, 5’5, w shorter legs, I wear a medium and ordered a medium. Depending on the way you’d want your dress to fit I’d say it was tt and hit perfect in length. If anything it may have ran big as I felt I could have fit a small. The white part around the sleeves has a button and no stretch so if you have bigger arms take that into consideration. I button them and put the dress on without an issue.I do not recall much stretch in the dress, but it also wasn’t needed. The cut was modest and comfy. I ended up going w a different outfit so I didn’t wash this. Not sure if you can tell in the pic but I did iron it just a tad bc it came super wrinkled. It was incredibly hard to iron the wrinkles out and every move I felt like was putting wrinkles back in. Although quality seemed nice The material was thick and hard to iron. I was worried I’d be a wrinkled mess by the time I arrived to the outdoor pics. Although I lived the look of the dress I sent it back bc I hate wrinkles. Maybe a steamer would have helped? Oh and it has pockets that do not pucker out. Overall it’s a great dress if you don’t mind to iron - I’m sure after every wash.

Does this dress actually have pockets? I can't see them in the main photo 
Yes, they are real and functional! The pockets are seamlessly integrated into the side seams with a flat design, so they don't add bulk to the A-line silhouette. You can comfortably carry your phone, keys, or a small lipstick. 
I want to wear this to a summer wedding. Is the white one see-through 
Not at all!!We specifically engineered the white and light-colored options with a thick weave to ensure zero transparency. 
Does this dress wrinkle badly after being folded in a suitcase? 
Not at all! The polyester-viscose blend is naturally wrinkle-resistant. When you unpack, simply hang the dress in the bathroom while you shower – the steam will release any minor creases within 5 minutes. No iron or steamer needed. 
Will the fabric pill or get those little fuzzy balls after washing? 
No pilling guaranteed! We use a high-twist yarn that prevents friction fuzzies even after multiple washes. Just remember to wash it inside out on a cold, gentle cycle and tumble dry low – the fabric will stay smooth and vibrant all season long.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Easy peasy throw-on type of dress
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: This has become one of those items I don't overwear, because it wonderfully serves the purpose of looking a bit more put together than my usual shorts and hoodies without any additional fuss, so I always want to be sure it's hanging in the closet ready to go.Last minute office day when I am feeling lazy?  Perfect.  Brunch with the girls?  Right on.  Hanging around the house having a cocktail with a buddy?  Of course.  This fall, it's going to look really cute with boots instead of the flats I've paired it with all summer.  Love this dress; writing this, I'm surprised I haven't purchased another one, and should probably rectify that.It's not high fashion, and it's not particularly flattering (very flowy, don't expect your waist to look snatched in this), but it's not NOT flattering, either, and definitely serves the purpose for lazier days when you're wanting to look a little less lazy than you're feeling.The fabric is soft and thick-ish without being stifling, it washes/dries well (and so far hasn't faded!), and oooh, do I love the pockets.I have the blue version of this as well, which I purchased by accident in a size too big (oh, should note, you can probably size down for this; I'm usually a large, and the medium was perfect), so I don't love it as much, but that's a size issue, not a dress issue.  I kept it because it's great for mellow days around the house when I don't mind looking and feeling like an old lady.
